note: Tuesday PM, Week 12. Claims: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (Tuten cover and Week 13 bye help with Taylor and Jeanty both off), Kaleb Johnson. Run gap: no board had been published since Nov. 10.

targets.hook: Tuten's handcuff; JAX starter if Tuten sits Week 12
targets.why: Bhayshul Tuten reaggravated his ankle in the Week 11 loss to the Giants, and Liam Coen called the recheck not too bad but said Tuten will be limited this week with a decision later (Yahoo Sports, Nov. 23). Rodriguez would lead the backfield if Tuten sits; he has not topped 11 carries in a game this season (FantasyPros, Nov. 24). He is the most-added player on Sleeper over the last 48 hours.
targets.asset: A conditional lead back: a starter only in weeks Tuten misses, short-yardage work otherwise.
targets.rate_basis: recent-trend (wk 11): snap 38%, touch 8%, 5 touches, rz 1; wks 9-11 snap 26%, 7 touches a game
targets.my_team_impact: You start Tuten at FLEX, and Week 13 takes Taylor and Jeanty away on the IND and LV byes. Rodriguez covers both problems: he starts for you if Tuten sits Sunday, and he is a usable FLEX in Week 13 either way.
targets.confidence_why: His own usage is a 26% snap share; the value is entirely conditional on Tuten's ankle.
targets.competition: Most-added player nationally. Only pauldag (93 left) and Stipe (89) have real money; ENOTS (3), DiaperDutyDaddy (2) and mfkr (11) are broke.
targets.bid: 14 dollars: above the contested 8-12 band to clear pauldag or Stipe on a handcuff they have no direct need for.
targets.drop: Seth McGowan: Out, and a pure Jonathan Taylor handcuff that costs you nothing to cut while Taylor is healthy.

targets.hook: GB lead back if Jacobs (finger) sits Wednesday
targets.why: Josh Jacobs is questionable for Wednesday's game at the Rams while recovering from finger surgery, with IR still possible (Yahoo Sports, Nov. 24). Johnson has 24 carries over the last two games with Jacobs out (RotoWire, Nov. 23).
targets.asset: An early-down starter in any week Jacobs misses, a bench back otherwise.
targets.rate_basis: no Week 11 line (GB bye); wks 9-10 per RotoWire: 24 carries over two games
targets.my_team_impact: A second Week 13 bye answer behind Rodriguez. Green Bay plays Wednesday, so he only helps you this week if Jacobs is ruled out before your lineup locks.
targets.confidence_why: Role exists only while Jacobs is out, and the Wednesday decision is unknown.
targets.competition: Not trending near the top; the rivals with money have not shown RB need in this week's feed.
targets.bid: 5 dollars: routine-to-contested; nobody with money is likely to chase a handcuff.
targets.drop: DeMario Douglas: Drake Maye is out indefinitely and Tommy DeVito starts, so his target role is worth little. Not scoopable in any way that hurts you.

targets.hook: Pass-down back with Brissett throwing 40+ a game
targets.why: Hill had 6 carries for 69 yards and a touchdown plus 4 catches at Carolina, and has 12 targets across Jacoby Brissett's two starts (Yahoo, Nov. 24). Derrick Henry cleared the concussion protocol, so the role stays a backup one; FantasyPros calls him fool's gold with no 10-carry games this season.
targets.asset: A passing-down back with a steady target floor and no rushing volume.
targets.rate_basis: recent-trend (wk 11): snap 55%, touch 19%, tgt 14%, 11 touches, rz 2; wks 9-11 touch 18%, 5 targets a game
targets.my_team_impact: Would not crack your lineup, and Baltimore is on bye in Week 13, the one week you need RB help.
targets.confidence_why: Three weeks of steady usage, but a low-ceiling role.
targets.competition: Trending, but the rivals with money have backs.

targets.why: Engram caught 6 of 8 targets for 74 yards against Las Vegas (CBS Sports, Nov. 24) and clears this league's median rostered tight end over both the last week and the window.
targets.asset: A target-earning tight end in Denver's passing game.
targets.rate_basis: window (wks 9, 11): snap 48%, tgt 20%, 6.5 targets a game; wk 11 tgt 25%
targets.my_team_impact: Same slot as Higbee: TE cover if LaPorta sits. Denver had its bye in Week 10.
targets.confidence_why: Sustained across two final weeks, but a 48% snap share.

targets.hook: Top healthy Rams pass catcher with Nacua, Ferguson done
targets.why: Puka Nacua and Terrance Ferguson are both out for the season (SI, Nov. 23), and Davante Adams is not due back before Week 13. Higbee has 31 catches for 304 yards on 43 targets (Yahoo, Nov. 24).
targets.asset: A streaming tight end with a bigger share of a thinned-out target tree.
targets.rate_basis: window (wks 9-10, LAR bye wk 11): snap 74%, tgt 13%, 4.5 targets a game
targets.my_team_impact: A fallback if LaPorta's Questionable tag turns into a missed game; Brenton Strange stays your starter.
targets.confidence_why: Clear path to targets, but a 13% share so far.
targets.competition: Several rivals stream TEs, but none in this week's feed has a TE hole with money.

targets.why: Felton has 17 targets across Kirk Cousins' two starts, with Jordan Addison hurt (thumb) and Jauan Jennings just back from a calf injury (CBS Sports, Nov. 24).
targets.asset: A volume receiver for as long as Addison is out.
targets.rate_basis: recent-trend (wk 11): snap 72%, tgt 28%, 12 targets; wks 9-11 tgt 17%
targets.my_team_impact: Not a starter over Odunze, Pickens or Egbuka; a Week 14 option when Pickens is on the DAL bye.
targets.confidence_why: One-week spike (last_week riser); his window share is 17%.

targets.why: Measured usage only: Cooper clears this league's median rostered receiver on both the last week and the window. No article this run explained the role, so treat the cause as unverified.
targets.asset: An every-down receiver on a run-first offense.
targets.rate_basis: window (wks 9, 11): snap 93%, tgt 24%, 6.5 targets a game
targets.my_team_impact: Bench depth; does not start over your three WRs.

targets.hook: Two TDs on a 64% snap share; role growing
targets.why: Hurst caught 5 of 7 for 56 yards and two touchdowns at Detroit, his snap share rose to 64%, and the team said it plans to feature him more (Yahoo, Nov. 24). RotoWire called the scores late and semi-fluky.
targets.asset: A rising third receiver with red-zone looks while Jalen McMillan is out.
targets.rate_basis: recent-trend (wk 11): snap 64%, tgt 23%, 7 targets, rz 2; wks 9, 11 tgt 13%
targets.my_team_impact: Bench depth behind Egbuka in the same offense.
targets.confidence_why: One game of usage at this level.

targets.hook: Barkley's handcuff, back from a foot injury
targets.why: Saquon Barkley left Week 11 with a left shoulder injury and was limited on Monday's estimate, though he expects to play Thanksgiving (Bleacher Report, Nov. 23). Shipley returned in Week 11 from a partial plantar fascia tear (FantasyPros, Nov. 24).
targets.asset: A volume start only if Barkley is ruled out.
targets.my_team_impact: Thursday game; useful to you only if Barkley sits and you need a Week 12 back.

targets.hook: Three TDs at Denver; you start Mahomes
targets.why: Mendoza threw for 267 yards and three touchdowns with 22 rushing yards at Denver (Yahoo, Nov. 24).
targets.asset: A streaming quarterback with some rushing.
targets.my_team_impact: Mahomes practiced fully Tuesday, so there is no QB need; LV is on bye in Week 13.

targets.hook: Snaps open with Nacua done, but few targets
targets.why: Mumpfield led Rams receivers with a 64% snap share before the bye (FantasyPros, Nov. 24), but Yahoo notes he has been held to 20 yards or less in most games.
targets.rate_basis: window (wks 9-10): snap 54%, tgt 9%, 3 targets a game
targets.confidence_why: Two weeks of low target share.

targets.why: Bernard caught 6 of 10 targets for 40 yards against Philadelphia after DK Metcalf was ejected (CBS Sports, Nov. 24).
targets.asset: A volume receiver for one week; Metcalf returns.
targets.rate_basis: recent-trend (wk 11): snap 94%, tgt 23%, 10 targets; wks 10-11 tgt 18%

targets.hook: 8-88-1 with Bowers out; LV bye in Week 13
targets.why: Bech caught 8 of 9 targets for 88 yards and a touchdown at Denver with Brock Bowers out (Yahoo, Nov. 24). FantasyPros lists him as fool's gold.
targets.asset: A one-game spike tied to Bowers' absence.
targets.rate_basis: recent-trend (wk 11): snap 79%, tgt 24%, 9 targets; wks 9-11 tgt 19%
targets.my_team_impact: Las Vegas is on bye in Week 13 alongside Jeanty, so he cannot cover that week.

targets.hook: Mitchell hurt, but Herbert in protocol
targets.why: Keaton Mitchell left Week 11 with knee and back injuries; RotoWire rates Vidal a desperation play (Nov. 23). Justin Herbert is in the concussion protocol (UPI, Nov. 23).
targets.asset: A share of a weak offense.
targets.rate_basis: window (wks 9-11): snap 33%, touch 13%, 7.7 touches a game
targets.my_team_impact: Not a Week 13 answer you would start.

targets.hook: High window share, 2 targets in Week 11
targets.why: Harris clears the league median over the three-week window, but drew only two targets in Week 11, and Justin Herbert is in the concussion protocol (UPI, Nov. 23).
targets.asset: A fading role in an offense losing its quarterback.
targets.confidence_why: Quarterback uncertainty and a falling last week.
